name: docs render: generated CLAUDE.md block
description: Write a generated block into CLAUDE.md: repo.yaml rules plus one line per feature (id, summary) and kinds with render: index. check fails when it is stale. Root CLAUDE.md shrinks to global rules + index.
author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>

comments.author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
comments.text: Merged 5837ca8. docs render [--check] [--json] -> { path, created, changed, stale }. Pure API: ClaudeMdBlock.Render(snapshot), ClaudeMdFile.Apply/IsStale/Check/Write. Markers <!-- docs:begin ... --> / <!-- docs:end -->; text outside them is kept byte for byte. repo.yaml entries render in full unless their kind is never; feature entries with index render one line; deprecated features are skipped. Added the DocsCommand<TSettings> base and the ErrorConsole registration; DocsFileException now exits 1. Malformed markers throw DocsFileException, which #28 should report as InvalidFile. A missing CLAUDE.md counts as stale.
